_doc: Small terrain decorations for the map's decoration layer (resource class sizes, 24-48 px, calmer than units and pickups): 4-6 per land terrain. One generate-image-v2 call per terrain at 48x48 returns 16 candidates of a mixed subject; the best distinct ones are accepted and cropped to their opaque box (plus 1 px). Layers: style, light, class-doodad, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one small meadow decoration, each image a different one of these: a round leafy green bush, a clump of tiny white and yellow wild flowers with leaves, a small grey stone with a tuft of grass, a low fern-like weed, a tiny mushroom pair. Muted greens #5f8f3e and #7fae4f, small and low, about half of the image wide.
recipes.negative: tree, flower pot, vase, person, animal, bright red, neon

recipes.subject: Subject: one small jungle floor decoration, each image a different one of these: a big leafy fern standing up, a small young palm with three or four broad fronds, a round boulder covered in green moss, a clump of broad tropical leaves, a mossy fallen log stub. Deep bluish greens #3f7f4a and #5a9f5c, mossy stone grey, small and low, about half of the image wide.
recipes.negative: tall tree, flower pot, person, animal, bright red, neon, yellow

recipes.subject: Subject: one small dry steppe decoration, each image a different one of these: a round tumbleweed of dry tangled straw-brown twigs, a bleached cream cattle skull with two curved horns, a small round green cactus, a low dry thorny shrub, a clump of tall dry straw grass with seed heads. Straw yellow #c9b06a, dry brown #8a6a3c, dusty sage green #8a9a5a, small and low, about half of the image wide.
recipes.negative: tree, flower pot, person, animal, bright red, neon, lush green

recipes.subject: Subject: one small red badlands decoration, each image a different one of these: a cluster of two or three red-brown rocks, a small round impact crater with a raised rim in red dust, a short flat-topped red sandstone mesa stub with layered stripes, a single tall red rock pillar, a few scattered red pebbles. Rust red #a85a3a, dark red-brown #6e3524, dusty orange #c98a5a, small and low, about half of the image wide.
recipes.negative: tree, plant, flower, person, animal, neon, green, blue

recipes.subject: Subject: one small ash wasteland decoration after a wildfire, each image a different one of these: a dead charred tree stump with broken roots, a little pile of bleached bones and a skull, a flat dark grey ash puddle with a few glowing orange embers, a few burnt twigs, a cracked grey stone. Ash grey #6e6862, charcoal #3a3634, bone cream #e0d6c0, tiny ember orange, small and low, about half of the image wide.
recipes.negative: living tree, green, leaves, flower, person, animal, neon, blood
